title: Sixth Buddhist Council Tipiṭaka (Chaṭṭhasaṅgītipiṭaka) — Unicode corpus
description:
A searchable, cross-referenced Unicode corpus of the official Sixth Buddhist Council (Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana) recension of the Pāḷi Tipiṭaka with its Aṭṭhakathā (commentaries) and Ṭīkā (subcommentaries) — 118 volumes, 86,365 paragraphs — converted from the legacy VZTimes-font edition published by the Ministry of Religious Affairs, Yangon (Pāḷi Series, romanised 2008 from the Myanmar version of 2001).

Includes structural extraction (printed pages, paragraphs, suttas), 55,240 variant readings transcribed from the printed apparatus with their sigla, 34,047 cross-references resolved from the edition's own footnote citations, and cross-layer paragraph linking.

This is not the VRI / Igatpuri (CST) digital edition, which is a different recension with its own editorial layer. Where the two differ, this corpus follows the official printed edition.

Browse the corpus at https://buddha-dhamma.net.
